score_notes.leadership: Reggie, Buster and Rodney, plus ministry leaders like those runnin’ Kids Korral or Trail Rides, share a vision: spread Christ’s love the cowboy way.
score_notes.preaching: Pastor Reggie Stewart and Associate Pastor Rodney Rickman preach messages that hit home, whether you’re in the pews or watchin’ from Waxahachie.
score_notes.mission: Sharing the gospel of Christ through cowboy culture, fellowship, and service to our community.
score_notes.cultural: Through charity, J Bar C Cowboy Church extends Christ’s love by serving and supporting those in need within our community.
score_notes.mens_discipleship: Men’s & Women’s Groups: Prayer Breakfasts, Cowgirl Roundup, and Mended Fences to grow together.
